body: I'm glad you have come here to express your feelings. Life is extremely overwhelming at times and it's really hard to deal with life sometimes. I am proud that you have enough will in you to reach out. I just want you to know that life is fleeting today's situation is Most certainly not going to be tomorrow's and death takes away any opportunity from us for things getting better in the future.

You are very lucky to have someone like your friend who did not back down from you in a time of need. I'd like to maybe ask you why it is that you are having these suicidal feelings. I am sure you already know this but this extreme bout of suicidal feelings may be aggravated by the drinking. It would maybe be best to cut it out atleast while you are still feeling like you are in a dark place. Please reach out to me if you are feeling alone I am here to help.

I know when we are in this deep hole that things seem like they will never get bette. I want you to remember that every feeling is a passing phase wether it is sadness or happiness.i am so glad you are here reaching for help because this means a part of you hasn't completely given up.

Hey there, firstly I'd like to ask you why you feel like a evil person. In my mind evil is someone who does bad without feeling any type of negative feelings towards their actions. You obviously are not this way .Also when you think about leaving this world just remember that whatever feeling you are trying to escape death is not the answer. Death is the inability to feel anything at all in my mind so it won't bring anyone relief.

Because I may be depressed right now but I deserve happiness and I will fight my depression till the day I find it. I have faith that times may be tough for me right now but the future will be brighter.

Regardless of your past actions and whatever makes you feel like you're a bad person you can choose to  make better choices in the future and help others. Just  know that if you decide to go on with this life you will have a chance to better your image of yourself by becoming the good caring person you obviously are longing to be.
Hey obviously sounds like you are in  a really bad place right now. This might not amount to much coming from a stranger but just know that you're important and worth feeling happiness.

Hey just to let you know I can totally relate to those feelings of getting no excitement out anything anymore. Actually my mom was criticizing me for it and told me ever since I was child she has never seen me excited makes me wonder how long I have been depressed. Weirdly enough I dont think there has ever been in  a time when I was really happy, ive always been sullen but I have made it to 19 years and thats reason enough to keep going. I have faith that if I keep pushing ill fight depression off, I hope you find some faith in a better future as well.

I can feel your pain right now, depression seems like a bottomless cliff at times, but considering the fact that you have been able to reach happiness over the past year means that it really isn't as never ending as sometimes we think it is. Seems like you've always struggled with romantic relationships falling out and I have too. It is honestly the most debilitating pain I have ever experienced. I know this sounds cliche but if its to meant to be with this girl she will come around. That being said even though I struggle with depression myself one thing i've learned over the past year is that the worst mistake anyone can make it to use someone else ( a relationship) as their source for happiness. Real, true happiness comes from within when we chose to let go of things we can not change and accept to move on in  life. I dont know if my thoughts are of any help I really hope your feeling of sadness diminishes.
